Primary request: restore this same map as a sharper, refined premium printed board illustration at high resolution. Fill the existing blank cream paper strips at the very edges, particularly the upper-left empty rounded rectangular label and the bottom border, with seamless continuations of the adjacent terrain or sea. Remove the black outer frame and label outline. Extend the blue sea through the upper-left label area and the nearest water areas to the canvas edges, and extend green land, fields and existing foothills naturally into the narrow remaining border strips. Keep all existing land/sea boundaries inside the map exactly where they are. The final picture must have actual map landscape or sea everywhere, edge-to-edge, with no empty parchment margins, no blank labels and no framing line.

Improve micro-detail and clarity while keeping the same six distinctive flat tints: turquoise north/northwest, orange northeast, magenta central-west, blue southwest, yellow central-east, purple south, with green surrounding neighboring lands. Keep contrast moderate so dark vector cities and network cost labels are easy to read.
Preserve the existing south-edge Alps where they are, but do not add mountain ranges across the six colored playable regions. Keep forests fine and scattered, do not create dense decorative clutter or giant peaks.
Composition and output: exact 3:4 portrait aspect ratio, north-up. Aim for at least 1800×2400 pixels; deliver at the highest supported resolution, with no added outer padding. This is a fidelity-preserving image edit, not a new interpretation.
No city names, no letters, no numbers, no roads, no power lines, no icons, no buildings, no map keys, no logos, no watermark, no title.
